physicalDetails.detail: Narrow man in sleeve-guards with a cold (wipes his nose on the back of his wrist), chewed pen, ink to the second knuckle; stands up and does not know what to do about having stood. Ears go red when embarrassed. Hand 'not steady' while copying.

voiceMarkers.detail: Fussy, rule-bound, small: 'The yard master's in Andorhal. Till the end of the week.', 'I can't show the books.', 'The ink thickens... Of a morning. The mornings are cold now. And the kettle.' Yields all at once once the fever news and the sacking are put to him; 'It started there,' hand to mouth; 'I know where they all are,' voice gone small.

beliefs.belief: The books are the yard's, the rule is the rule since his father had the book; the load is booked, not the man.
beliefs.trueOrFalse: Honest but the rule blinds him: no carter's name was ever written.

goalsAtChapterEnd.active: Copy out the short-rate lines for the Ranger-General; deal with his master when he returns.
goalsAtChapterEnd.underlying: Keep his post and keep his hands clean.

emotionalStateAtChapterEnd.state: Frightened and shaky but cooperative; gives Jaina a cup of tea without a word.

decisionsThisChapter.detail: Refused the books, then opened the sheepskin out-book after Lyriel's talk and Sylvanas's offer of the sacking; named the 'And.' rule and the 'own cart' free carters; helped place villages on the map ('Coldwell's past the bridge'); sat with Cyndia and copied every short-rate line with the dates for Sylvanas; told her to tell his master to write to Silvermoon.

abilitiesDemonstrated.ability: Knows the geography of every village his book names.

bodyLanguagePatterns.detail: Breathes through his mouth; swallows; goes red to the ears; a hand to his mouth when 'it started there'.

knowledge.detail: The carters' names are never written; 'Own cart' loads from midsummer; the yard master is in Andorhal; he knows where all 31 short-rate places are.

arc.currentPosition: Cooperative witness who stays at his post; contrasted with the river-depot overseer. Do not bring back unless it is a Silvermoon follow-up.
